correctness.rationale: For 0<u=1−exp(−h)<1, every ordered edge-exponential sweep is stochastic, irreducible and aperiodic. The pre-update mass at vertex i is pi_i+J*1_{r_{i−1}<r_i}; conservation gives constant flux J=u/(n−um), hence exact pi_i=(1−u*d_i)/(n−um). I independently checked a rational n=5 update-order example by multiplying its matrices and verifying stationarity. Summing absolute deviations yields TV=u*m*(n−m)/(n(n−u m)), with 1<=m<=n−1; one-variable calculus maximizes the envelope at t=m/n=1/(1+sqrt(1−u)), equal tanh(h/4). Cyclic conjugation of any sweep matrix yields a circulant doubly stochastic average and exact uniform invariance. The proof covers all n and h, whereas finite checker enumeration is corroboration.
